Ridgeline plots are an alternative to compare distributions across different categories. Technically, they are a set of overlapping density plots, where each one represents a different category.

To access the source code and replicate this chart, visit my [Blog](/blog/posts/vietnam-rainfall-ridgeline-plot/index.html).
